description:
Long-Lasting Power for Extended Rides
The HITWAY BK15 PRO features a high-capacity 36V 13Ah lithium-ion battery (468Wh), designed to provide an impressive range of 60-100 km (37-62 miles) on a single charge. Whether you're commuting in the city or exploring scenic trails, this extended range ensures you can enjoy uninterrupted rides without worrying about recharging. With a top speed of 25 km/h (15.5 mph), the battery delivers reliable performance for long-distance journeys, offering a seamless and enjoyable riding experience.
Stable and Reliable Performance
The 27.5×2.35-inch puncture-resistant pneumatic tires are designed for optimal stability and traction, whether on city roads or rough trails. Paired with mechanical disc brakes, the BK15 PRO ensures consistent stopping power and reliable performance, providing confidence and control even in wet or uneven conditions.
Powerful Motor and Shimano 7-Speed Drivetrain
The HITWAY BK15 PRO is equipped with a 250W hub motor, delivering smooth and efficient power to tackle diverse terrains. With a Shimano 7-speed drivetrain and three levels of pedal assist, you can effortlessly adapt to varying riding conditions. The pedal assist allows you to adjust your speed according to your needs: Level 1 (15 km/h), Level 2 (20 km/h), and Level 3 (25 km/h). Whether you're cruising through the city or navigating challenging paths, the bike offers a versatile and responsive riding experience with minimal effort.
Smooth Ride with Front Fork Suspension
Designed to absorb shocks and vibrations, the front fork suspension enhances comfort and ride quality on uneven surfaces. Whether you're commuting in the city or tackling bumpy terrain, the suspension system ensures a smooth, stable ride, reducing strain on your body and allowing you to ride longer with ease.
